aggregation: category macro within seed, then mean and sample standard deviation over seeds
notes: Strict-image class metrics retain their original evaluation because raw image scores are unavailable.
CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST feature metrics use the tie-corrected evaluator.
Pixel maps are regenerated by training/evaluation; they are not distributed as reference data.
strict_epoch_derivation: 20 configuration epochs multiplied by the recorded epochs_mult=2 command override; effective budget40, not base budget20.
